text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-48712 fired for service="model-catalog" - elevated 5xx + tokenizer errors on /v1/route. Priority: P1. Details: tokenizer resolution failures after recent promotion.

pagerduty: PD-48712 assigned to Emily - eng-oncall

Emily - eng-oncall: acked. I'm taking this. Posting initial triage.

Raj - eng-runtime: seeing bursts of `TokenizerNotFoundError` in logs for model_id="m-bert-large" revision="rev-2026-03-09". Errors started ~2144999920, spike after catalog promotion job at 2144999905.

Sylvia - eng-sre: +1. Graphs show 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% -> 3.8% over 2m. Latency also up for requests hitting that model route.

Marco - eng-platform: I can confirm the catalog entry for `m-bert-large` was promoted by the automated rollout at 2144999904. Promotion payload included `tokenizer: null` (unexpected). Suspect config generator bug.

Emily - eng-oncall: copying logs and example trace: ```
ERROR TokenizerNotFoundError: tokenizer not found for model rev rev-2026-03-09
   at CatalogResolver.resolve (/srv/catalog/resolver.py:72)
   at RequestHandler.handle (/srv/runtime/handler.py:210)
```

Raj - eng-runtime: quick grep shows 87 failures across 3 hosts. Hostlist: runtime-02, runtime-07, runtime-11. The runtime falls back to default tokenizer which is sometimes incompatible -> downstream tokenization mismatches and then downstream failure in tokenization pipeline.

Sylvia - eng-sre: Customer impact estimate?:
- 5% of text-generation calls returned 5xx to customers in US-west region (observed via ingress logs)
- embeddings/semantic-search unaffected

Emily - eng-oncall: tagging CSE. @sylvia can you spin up an increase in log retention for related routes and open a PD incident timeline? I'll start mitigation.

Sylvia - eng-sre: On it. Retention bumped and added trace sampling. PD timeline created: https://pd.re/incident/PD-48712 (internal).

Marco - eng-platform: mitigation options: a) roll back catalog to previous revision rev-2026-03-02, b) patch catalog entry to set tokenizer field to explicit "spm-v2" for the new rev, c) add a temporary route filter to divert traffic from promoted variant.

Emily - eng-oncall: option (a) quickest. Marco, can you trigger a rollback? If not, I'll promote a hotfix to force tokenizer for that entry.

Marco - eng-platform: rolling back now. Command I'm running: ```
curl -X POST https://catalog.internal/api/v1/promotions/rollback \
  -d '{"model_id":"m-bert-large","target_revision":"rev-2026-03-02"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

incident-bot: rollback job queued id=rb-2145000001 - started on controller-03

Raj - eng-runtime: I see older revision being re-pinned on runtime nodes. Errors dropping on runtime-02 within 20s. 5xx rate falling.

Sylvia - eng-sre: Metrics: 5xx now down to 0.4% and trending to baseline. Marking as mitigated.

Emily - eng-oncall: ack rollback success. PD-48712 -> status: mitigated. I'm going to open a follow-up to prevent recurrence and notify impacted customers.

Marco - eng-platform: root cause: catalog promotion pipeline allowed an empty/null tokenizer attribute through when the model metadata generator didn't include the tokenizer field for this model family. Failing fast during promotion should've caught it.

Raj - eng-runtime: action items: add a runtime defensive check to reject catalog entries with missing tokenizer; add a metric emitter for tokenizer resolution failures.

Sylvia - eng-sre: ops actions: create alert that fires at 0.5% tokenizer-resolution-5xx across any route for 2m. Also add runbook steps for rollback and customer communication template.

Emily - eng-oncall: customer impact draft: "We detected an elevated error rate for a small subset of text-generation requests caused by a catalog promotion applying an incomplete model config. We rolled back the promotion and error rates have returned to normal. Affected customers: approx 5% of requests in US-west between 2144999920-2145000080. No data exfiltration observed." Posting to #support to start outreach.

Marco - eng-platform: creating PR to convert promotion pipeline validation to schema-validate on `tokenizer` and other required fields. PR: https://git.internal/r/platform/+/2345.

Raj - eng-runtime: deploying runtime guard now (fast patch) -> pushing a canary on runtime-11 with a defensive check. Command: `kubectl apply -f runtime-guard-canary.yaml`.

incident-bot: PD-48712 status changed to: resolved (post-mitigation monitoring window passed).

Emily - eng-oncall: resolving thread. I'll hand off long-term follow-ups to Marco and Raj. Next oncall, @sylvia please finish the postmortem with timeline and customer communication.

Sylvia - eng-sre: will do. Creating incident doc and sending follow-up summary to ops-chat and support.

Marco - eng-platform: note for postmortem: consider adding a pre-promotion smoke test that runs a tiny tokenization probe against the specified tokenizer to catch missing/invalid tokenizers.

Emily - eng-oncall: thanks all. Closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
